parameters.label: central volume
parameters.covariate_model: V1 = 6.09 L (absolute; Shafer 1990 standard adult, valid ~40-90 kg)

extraction.tier_rationale: Source-filled from open reproductions of the Shafer 1990 STANPUMP fentanyl set (opentiva micro-rate constants k10 0.0827, k12 0.471, k13 0.225, k21 0.102, k31 0.006 -> V1 6.09; cross-checked vs the OpenTCI/Mandel MATLAB volume/clearance arrays). Absolute (not weight-scaled) in the canonical adult parameterization.

Parameters SOURCE-FILLED (V1 6.09, V2 28.1, V3 228 L; Cl1 0.504, Cl2 2.87, Cl3 1.37 L/min; ke0 0.147) from two independent open reproductions of the Shafer 1990 STANPUMP fentanyl set (opentiva micro-rate constants and the OpenTCI/Mandel MATLAB arrays, which agree to displayed precision). KERNEL STILL PENDING: simulate() continues to refuse this model until a human confirms the values against the primary PDF and a verified kernel is wired. Absolute (not weight-scaled) for the standard 40-90 kg adult; the Shafer 'pharmacokinetic mass' adjustment applies above ~80 kg.

source_review.reviewed_by: automated source cross-check (Claude Opus 4.8 via Hypnos research agents)
source_review.method: fetched two open implementations of the Shafer 1990 fentanyl model and reconciled their micro-rate constants / volume-clearance arrays to the displayed precision
source_review.notes: V1 6.09, V2 28.1, V3 228 L and Cl1 0.504, Cl2 2.87, Cl3 1.37 L/min agree across both sources (opentiva micro-rate constants k10 0.0827/k12 0.471/k13 0.225/k21 0.102/k31 0.006 reduce exactly to the OpenTCI volume/clearance arrays). ke0: 0.147 (OpenTCI/Mandel, the curated value) vs 0.12 (opentiva) — a real implementation split, flagged. Specifically the SHAFER set, distinct from the Scott/McClain fentanyl models. Primary Anesthesiology PDF paywalled (not directly read). HUMAN ITEMS: confirm against the primary table, resolve the ke0 0.147-vs-0.12 split, and wire/verify the kernel before simulation is enabled.

notes: Parameters source-filled from open Shafer-1990 reproductions (pending_human_review); KERNEL STILL PENDING until human verification + a wired kernel. The volumes/clearances are absolute (standard adult). sufentanil (Gepts) and alfentanil (Maitre) are future siblings.
